status: component RED/GREEN; ordinary mixed-upload comparison prevents acceptance
composition: Both executables include the same archived native receive/excess and Native/Product qualification candidates. Only the archived mailbox-wake patch differs.
build: release, locked, no features; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1; build and benchmark never overlap

service.qos: downstream 500 -> 10 -> 500 Mbps at 15 and 25 seconds when enabled
service.outage: UDP only at 30..33 seconds when enabled

cautions: Random sequential trials are not identical packet realizations or proof of statistical confidence.
Loss/jitter-only tags disable QoS and outage, not asymmetric jitter.
Upload confirmation includes reverse-direction feedback; confirmation gaps are not independent target-arrival timestamps.
Application/confirmation one-second bins above the routed rate are buffered release, not physical bandwidth.
Read gaps alone miss sustained trickle: mixed candidate download has several 3..5 Mbps seconds despite a maximum read gap below one second.
Two mixed-upload candidate runs are 168.749 and 164.741 Mbps; controls are 237.239 and 259.990 Mbps. Do not accept, waive or attribute this difference to a particular endpoint before isolation.
No native or allocation policy, buffer, rate hint or timer changed for the mailbox candidate.
No release or public performance claim follows from these results.
